stem: A paper fan opens into the shape of a sector of a circle with a radius of 6 inches. When fully open, the fan has an area of \(15\pi\) square inches. What is the measure, in degrees, of the central angle of the open fan?
solution: The fan is \(\frac{15\pi}{36\pi} = \frac{5}{12}\) of the circle.
verify:
t=symbols('t',positive=True)
s=solve(Eq(t/360*pi*6**2,15*pi),t)
assert s==[150]
assert Rational(spr_answers[0])==s[0]
